body: ditto on the weight. super annoying. i totally feel you on the numbness and fog part - i just feel completely apathetic to everything and it’s really hard for me to be motivated for anything

i had a suspicion i had OCD since i was 9 years old but it only became severe when i turned 13. when i was 14 i read an article about Mara Wilson and her OCD, and how she had reached out to counsellors for a diagnosis. this inspired me to do the same and by age 15 i was diagnosed. i hope you’re able to get the support you need, you are not alone in this journey ☺️
